name: ShunSin Technology Holdings Limited
summary: ShunSin Technology Holdings Limited engages in the assembly, testing, and sale of various integrated circuits related to semiconductors in Mainland China, the United States, Taiwan, Malaysia, Singapore, Ireland, and internationally. The company's products include system in package module, including 2G/2.5G/3G/4G front end and power Amplifier (PA), multi-mode multi band power amplifier, WiFi front end, mobile WiFi, and antenna switch modules; passive optical components; optical transceivers; thick film integrated circuit; and MEMS modules and sensors, such as accelerometers, gyroscopes, G-sensors, pressure and gesture sensors, light and proximity sensors, BAW filters, and TOF sensors.
